name: legion-dev-critic
description: Execution grader. Extracts the solution file from a candidate answer, runs the task's pytest spec against it in an isolated subprocess with a timeout, and (for the security tasks) checks no forbidden secret literal was echoed. Pass = the tests pass. Below-threshold candidates are dropped (rejection sampling).
gate: the task's own pytest tests must pass (returncode 0); no forbidden literal present
eval_mode: The same grader scores the trained model on the frozen, held-out task set (legion_dev.evaluate / evaluate_hf) as pass@1, so a training pair can't be accepted under looser rules than the model is later judged by.
notes: Reproducible by construction: solution runs against pristine tests (the model can't pass by editing tests), fresh temp dir per run, hard wall-clock timeout, no bytecode cache.
